sources.evidence_slice: Historic England's official Open Data Hub publishes National Heritage List for England layer 3 as 'Listed Building polygons'. The layer is esriGeometryPolygon, supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF queries, and exposes ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields. Historic England's download page identifies listed buildings as polygons as official NHLE open data under the Open Government Licence. The selected Open Data Hub explore window was readable, but its record-level query payload could not be retrieved, so no feature geometry was accepted.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and supports GeoJSON, but no record-level polygon coordinates were retrieved in this window.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer exposes ListEntry, Name and Grade fields; without a returned feature payload no record-bound building identity/type-use value was read.
field_evidence.licensing: Historic England states NHLE GIS spatial data is available under the Open Government Licence.
